name: Git Info
description: Exposes the deployed code's Git branch/commit via a block and tokens (do not expose publicly).
project_description:
Some useful helpers to display info about the revision of your codebase on the site.

 It can be a git tag, git revision, date for last commit, or a combination of all.

 This can be useful for knowing what version is deployed of your product at different servers, and for supplying together with bug reports.

 This is what powers the version string on Violinist.io where you can get free, automated composer updates for life!
